acceptance: validate (or orchestrate plan) warns when a roster entry with a reviewer or executor role matches no model profile by api_id, file name or alias, naming the entry and the closest profile; the shipped profiles carry aliases for the harness ids they document (for example cursor-grok-4.6-high and gpt-5.6-sol-high); a test covers a matched and an unmatched roster id
nodes.title: Every roster model reaches its profile notes

acceptance: A reviewer run that filed its review record for the commit under review is recorded as complete with no error in RUN-<model>.json, and the 'no review record was filed' error appears only when no record for that commit exists after the run; a test covers both
nodes.title: A completed reviewer run does not report a missing record

acceptance: A tracked project file (for example constraints/review-lessons.md, created by init project with a short header) lists known defect classes, one per entry with a one-line rule and an optional example, and every reviewer prompt includes its entries under a 'Project review lessons' heading; a test pins the inclusion

specy-road lessons add --rule <text> [--example <text>] [--from <NODE_ID>] appends an entry and specy-road lessons list prints them; an entry naming --from records the leaf it came from; tests cover add, list and a missing file
nodes.title: Review lessons: escaped defect classes feed every reviewer prompt

acceptance: orchestration.yaml policy accepts an optional strong_review list, each item naming touch-zone paths or directory prefixes and the roster ids allowed to count as the strong approval (for example zones: [specy_road/review_gate.py, specy_road/schemas/], require_one_of: [gpt-5.6-sol-medium, claude-opus-5-5-review]); the review gate, handoff status and mark-implementation-reviewed require at least one counting approval from that set when the leaf's touch zones intersect an item, and name the unmet item when they refuse

orchestrate plan shows, for each ready leaf, which strong_review item applies and which reviewers can satisfy it; tests cover a leaf inside and outside a strong zone, an approval from the set and one from outside it
nodes.title: Leaves that touch high-risk zones need a stronger reviewer

acceptance: roadmap/git-workflow.yaml accepts an optional verify_cmd (for example 'python -m pytest -n 4 -p no:cacheprovider') that executor briefs and reviewer prompts give as the command to run the leaf's tests (with test paths appended), separate from land_check_cmd; when it is unset the prompts say to cap parallel test workers when other workers share the machine

docs/orchestration-workers.md explains that concurrent workers each running a full parallel suite oversubscribe the CPU, and recommends verify_cmd with a small worker count plus land_check_cmd for the full suite at landing; tests cover the prompt text with and without verify_cmd
nodes.title: Executors and reviewers run tests with a bounded worker count
